name: thear_copy
description: Over-confident, overpowering tank. Hacks one-handed out of contempt and never stops coming; when he finally takes the cleaver in both hands, the earth itself comes down. His blade is two swords locked together.
note: Exported by Rig Forge from an imported package. Frames face right; the image centre (origin_px) is the figure's position in-game; anchors are image px per frame. "rigforge" holds the rig and keyframes so Rig Forge can import this package exactly. FX live in <name>.fxkit.json in this folder.
